entries.reason: OpenAPI required must be an array; preserves the declared field.
Move required:true from path parameter schema to parameter. No request field added.
RefreshTokenResponse and WalletGrantRefreshTokenResponse overlap structurally, so validate token responses by the request grant type. Do not alter upstream oneOf.

Provisional local interoperability choice: examples omit undefined Account.name. Remove name from runtime required by default; STRICT_ACCOUNT_NAME=true restores the upstream requirement. Uber owner approval is outstanding (U1).
Use declared CONFIRMED/PENDING/REJECTED, not contradictory SUCCEEDED/FAILED examples.
Use declared enum, not example SUCCEEDED. CANCELLED lookup returns declared400/empty in local profile until owner confirms mapping.
Initial rejection uses declared400 with detail; never emit initial REJECTED outside enum. Async rejection uses payoutCallback.
Only full capture enabled; partial amount returns declared400 VALIDATION_ERROR until semantics agreed.

All six callback builders tested; demo charge/refund/payout use corresponding modern callback. Legacy deposit callbacks are explicit client/test functions, not automatic charge routing. Deposit cash-in/top-up orchestration and amount-update semantics remain unimplemented pending U11; builders alone are not flow coverage.

Unexpected infrastructure or database failures return retryable HTTP 500 on every route, including routes without a declared 5xx. Such undeclared responses have an empty body and are never replay-persisted. Auth failures retain declared per-route statuses; this is a provisional deviation, not approved by Uber.

Use reusable refresh tokens with no rotated refresh_token field in AccessTokenResponse in all languages; lifetime defaults to configurable 30 days. Reuse of an authorization code revokes its issued token family. Rotation/reuse-grace policy awaits Uber client confirmation.
Follow declared 422 and a BANK_HARD_ERROR or BANK_SOFT_ERROR detail, not diagram 200 REJECTED. No debit occurs and the local authorization hold is released.
Follow the empty 200 response schema, not diagram 200 {state:CANCELLED}.
Lookup uses the Uber transaction ID (or Uber refund ID), not diagram psp_reference. merchant_reference mismatch returns declared404.
Always include psp_reference on rejected charge callbacks, following the required schema rather than optional prose.
Code exchange returns a refresh token only, following the declared schema, not the diagram showing an access token too.
Use account_id and funding_method per schema, not diagram payment_instrument.
Use original_transaction_id/original_merchant_reference/CurrencyAmount and 201 CONFIRMED/PENDING/REJECTED per schema, not the conflicting request/status diagram.
Changed payload under a payout ID or idempotency key returns declared409 DUPLICATE_REQUEST_ERROR; identical payload replays. Other operations keep their own declared mappings.
Retain source_account_id for reconciliation. No bilateral file format, cadence, SFTP or delivery promise is invented by the local reference.
